item.title: fix(ui,gateway): refresh the agents-page model catalog on picker open…
item.summary: fix(ui,gateway): refresh the agents-page model catalog on picker open and give catalog errors a next step (#124019) The agents-page model catalog was cached per agent for the whole connection: availability facts (provider keys added/removed, new models) went stale with no refresh path except a full reconnect, while the chat composer's sibling picker refreshes on open. Opening the overview picker now re-reads through the same ensureModelCatalog owner with a refresh bypass of the per-agent cache. sessions.patch's 'model catalog unavailable' error told the operator nothing actionable; it now states the catalog is still loading and to retry — the failure text names the next step per doctrine.
